original_ai_output.title_zh: 几内亚比绍选举委员会称12月选举条件未满足
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 几内亚比绍选举委员会表示，原定于12月举行的立法和总统选举所需条件尚未满足，选举前景陷入不确定。此次选举旨在去年11月政变后恢复文官统治，军方领导人此前通过了为期一年的过渡宪章。随着12月选举期限临近，该国已连续数周陷入严重的政治与安全动荡。

key_facts.fact: 几内亚比绍选举委员会称12月选举条件未满足
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Guinea-Bissau's planned December legislative and presidential polls are in limbo after the electoral commission on Thursday said conditions to hold them had not been met.

key_facts.fact: 选举旨在去年11月政变后恢复文官统治
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: They are meant to restore civilian rule after a coup last November after which the military leaders adopted a year-long transitional charter.

key_facts.fact: 该国已连续数周陷入严重政治与安全动荡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: As the December deadline for the polls approaches, the country has been gripped by significant political and security turmoil for several weeks.

uncertainties: 选举是否及何时举行尚不确定
